create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with task IDs to track simulation attempt results
test_maybe_log_attempt: test logging simulation attempts for each task using maybe_log_attempt with success or failure status
compute_metrics: compute raw metrics including independent_solved_by and global_solved_by from an evaluator log
compute_normalized_metrics: compute normalized metrics with AUC values by calling compute_all_metrics on an Evaluator
create_dev_set: create a development set from a base eval setup with a specified train share and random seed
